changes_from_v0_1: All 500 items now have rubric (full 6-anchor for Q100, compact 4-anchor for the rest).
All items have `evidence` field (required keywords/phrases the extractor must locate).
Added `mode: external` for items that require lookup beyond manuscript text.

7 new items added: BIAS_041..045 (causal inference: target trial emulation, time zero, eligibility at t0, treatment window, prevalent user bias) + AIPRED_041..042 (data leakage check, calibration-in-the-large).

7 duplicates marked with `relation: {of:..., kind: subtype}` instead of deleted: POPUL_018→BIAS_001, POPUL_021→BIAS_024, OUTCM_040→AIPRED_016, STATS_030→BIAS_014, STATS_037→AIPRED_004, EXTV_001 (kept canonical) / AIPRED_026 (subtype), INTERP_024→RELEV_018.
Total items: 500 + 7 new = 507. The relation-marked subtype items remain scoreable but the downstream aggregation should down-weight them via the `relation.kind=subtype` rule (see schema).
